narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Every letter climbs up once, so the top is eigh plus bee plus see plus dee.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it with four ones. The rows become twos, then fours, and the top is eight.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Four ones add to four, not eight, so some letters count more than once.
